summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video: Hanfu Production p05 - Overall Details ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will focus on the overall details of hanfu production using Marvelous Designer. This video will guide you through various steps to ensure precision and quality in your design. ## Activating and Extending the Bag All the panels are frozen. Next, activate the bag and extend it to the appropriate position. After the length is increased, freeze the tree. ## Adjusting the Top Layer Activate the top layer to adjust the sleeve part. It is best to adjust the size of the top layer before reducing it to a size of 5. Otherwise, the speed of operation will be slow, making it inconvenient to check the effect. ## Extending the Sleeve Extend the side of the sleeve to its desired length. After extending the sleeve, the panel may penetrate the model's hand. ### Using the Selection Grid Tool To quickly wear the sleeve out, utilize the selection grid tool. Select the grid in the 2D window and pull it out in the 3D window. Once the model is opened, the fabric will no longer interspersed with the model. Continue to extend the sleeve. After doing so, if the hem of the sleeve does not look good, reduce the fineness of the hem and simulate again. ## Creating the Thinning Board 接着我们开始制作披薄 (Next, we begin making the thinning board). 1. Create a rectangular board. 2. Make the board wider and longer. 3. Move the board to the center. 4. Add a pin to the board. 5. Open the simulation and hang the board on the board. ### Adjusting the Board Drag the board to the center multiple times until it is positioned correctly. Remove the fixing pin in the back and pull the thinning board to start the simulation. After a short time, pause the simulation and sew the two boards together. Then, remove the fixing pin on the front side and adjust the placement of the board. ## Selecting Fabric for the Thinning Board Select a new fabric for the thinning board. Ensure that the thinning board is positioned correctly on the front side. To achieve a stacking effect, reduce the end speed to 80%. ## Final Adjustments As you finalize the thinning board, adjust the physical properties of the plated fabric to match the formwork material. After stabilizing, reduce the diameter of the particle and the diameter of the surface. Add a row of fixed needles on both sides and gradually increase the slope rate to 100%. Then simulate the changes. ### Modifying the Skirt Version Activate the skirt version to modify the wrinkle effect. If the wrinkles are not detailed enough, consider reducing the particle diameter first to observe the effects. Resetting the grid can also help smooth out the wrinkles. After resetting, the grid will rearrange according to the panels' positions in the 2D window. ## Final Considerations If there is a gap between the model's hands and feet, it may be due to the model's grid being smaller than the clothing grid. Reduce the particle diameter and continue to simulate until the simulation stabilizes with no gaps. Finally, move all the panels. Previously, we applied four-dimensional fabric to the clothing, which is relatively soft and light. If the density of the fabric is lower, the effect of natural water may not be obvious enough. Activate the panels and increase the density of the fabric as needed. ## Conclusion When launching the chamfer, observe how the material behaves. The simple Nadam's hanfu is now complete. Thank you for watching, and see you in the next video! ```
